question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

45 * 9 * 3 * 7 * 5 * 21
solution:
Explanation :

BODMAS table

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

 Given equation : 45*9*3*7*5*21

**Option 1 : ÷, +, × , -, = **by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• **45 ÷ 9 **+ 3 × 7 - 5 = 21
 
• 5 + 3 × 7 - 5 = 21
 
• **5 + 21** - 5 = 21
 
• 26 - 5 = 21
 
• **21 = 21 ( LHS = RHS )**

Option 2. : -, ÷, +, × , = by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• 45 - **9 ÷ 3** + 7 × 5 = 21
 
• 45 - 3 +** 7 × 5** = 21
 
• **45** - 3 + **35 **= 21
 
• **80 - 3** = 21
 
• 77 ≠ 21(LHS ≠ RHS )

Option 3 : × , +, ÷, -, = by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• 45 × 9 + **3 ÷ 7** - 5 = 21
 
• **405 + 0.42** - 5 = 21
 
• **405.42 - 5 **= 21
 
• 400.42 ≠ 51(LHS ≠ RHS )

Option 4 : -, +, × , ÷, = by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• 45 - 9 + 3 ×** 7 ÷ 5 **= 21
 
• 45 - 9 + **3 ×**** 1.4** = 21
 
• **45 **- 9 +** 4.2** = 21
 
• 49.2 - 9 = 21
 
• 40.2 ≠ 21(LHS ≠ RHS )

Hence, **"÷, +, × , -, =" ** is the correct answer.
